methods.summary: List candidate reference clips
methods.description: Returns the best 5 windows over all parts (best first, the first recommended) plus the media pool's best windows, with preview WAVs, the current reference and the detected reference language. Errors: bad_request, not_found (voice).

methods.name: voices.reference_from_media
methods.summary: Build a reference from many media files
methods.description: Starts a job that cleans and joins many media files of the speaker into a pool and writes its best 8-12 s window to reference.wav or reference_<language>.wav. Answers {job} at once and reports through voices.media.* events; a cancelled or failed job changes nothing. Errors at start: bad_request, not_found (voice), busy (a generation or a media job for this voice runs).

paths.description: 1 to 500 files of the same speaker

items.description: Absolute path of an audio or video file

language.description: Omitted, "", "auto" or the voice language: reference.wav; another speech language: reference_<language>.wav

remove_music.description: Remove background music: true (every file), false (never) or "auto" (null too): video files with an SNR under 35 dB, only on CUDA with no training holding the GPU

methods.name: voices.remove_reference
methods.summary: Remove a per-language reference clip
methods.description: Deletes reference_<language>.wav and its sidecar. Errors: bad_request, not_found (voice or no such reference), busy.

references.description: Languages that still have their own reference clip

methods.name: voices.set_reference
methods.summary: Pick the reference clip by hand
methods.description: Cuts a 3-40 s range of a part (or of the media pool with source "media") into the reference as a manual choice, drops the conditioning cache and starts voices.warm. Errors: bad_request, not_found (voice, part or media pool), busy (a generation is running).

part.description: Part index to cut from (from 1); not with source "media"

source.description: Cut from the media pool instead of a part

oneOf.description: The reference clip cut from a part

oneOf.description: A reference clip cut from the media pool

file.description: 1-based index of the source file in the pool request

language.description: With source "media": the pool language, or null

methods.name: voices.warm
methods.summary: Warm a voice up in the background
methods.description: Precomputes the speaker conditioning of reference.wav (and loads a trained voice's RVC model) in the background, ending with the voice.warm event. Errors: not_found (voice or no reference.wav), not_ready, no_memory.

reason.description: Why it did not start (only when warming is false); busy means a generation is running

methods.name: shutdown
methods.summary: Shut the engine down
methods.description: Answers {} and then the engine exits.
